project: Personal Trainer App - Trainer Feature Tests
description: Comprehensive test suite for trainer-facing features using devtool devbar with trainer role

test_suites.description: Test trainer login flow using email and password (traditional auth)

tests.title: Access login screen as unauthenticated trainer
steps: 1. Kill app or logout to unauthenticated state
2. App should redirect to /login screen
3. Verify LoginScreen displays 'Email' and 'Password' fields
4. Both fields should be empty and focused on email field
tests.expected_result: LoginScreen renders with email and password inputs ready for entry

tests.title: Send magic link (trainer uses magic link too)
steps: 1. Enter valid trainer email in TextField
2. Tap 'Send Magic Link' button (note: trainers also use magic link)
3. Observe loading spinner while request is in flight
4. Wait for response from backend
tests.expected_result: Screen transitions to MagicLinkVerificationScreen showing success message

tests.title: Verify magic link code input (trainer version)
steps: 1. MagicLinkVerificationScreen should display trainer email used
2. Code input field should show 6 placeholder slots
3. Keyboard should auto-open on screen load
4. Input 123456 (test code for dev mode)
tests.expected_result: Code field accepts input, auto-advances after 6 digits entered

tests.title: Verify biometric auth after code verification
steps: 1. After code verification succeeds, BiometricAuthScreen displays
2. Show 'Use Face ID/Touch ID to complete login' message
3. Verify biometric options available on device
4. Tap biometric auth button (or use device biometric)
tests.expected_result: Biometric prompt appears; on success navigates to trainer /dashboard

test_suites.description: Test trainer login using dev token directly from devtool devbar

tests.title: Access devtool devbar with trainer role
steps: 1. Shake device to open dev menu (or long-press home on simulator)
2. Find 'DevDataSeeder' or 'Dev Tools' section in devbar
3. Locate 'Switch Role' option
4. Select 'trainer' from dropdown
tests.expected_result: Dev bar shows 'Current Role: trainer' with trainer dev token displayed

tests.title: Dev token automatically sets trainer session
steps: 1. After selecting trainer role in devbar, tap 'Apply' or 'Save'
2. App should automatically navigate away from login screen
3. AuthStateProvider should emit authenticated state with trainer user
4. Observe network logs showing authorization header with dev token
tests.expected_result: App navigates to trainer /dashboard, authStateProvider shows non-null trainer user

tests.title: Verify trainer profile endpoint returns user data
steps: 1. After authenticated as trainer, open DevTools network tab
2. Make request to GET /api/v1/auth/me
3. Verify response contains user_type='trainer'
4. Verify response contains trainer fields (email, name, id)
tests.expected_result: HTTP 200 response with user data: {user_type: 'trainer', email: '...', name: '...', id: '...'}

test_suites.description: Test trainer profile display, customization, and verification

tests.title: Display trainer own profile
steps: 1. Authenticate as trainer via devtool
2. Navigate to Profile tab/screen
3. Verify profile displays: avatar, name, email, bio, experience years
4. Verify displays stats: total clients, total workouts created, rating
tests.expected_result: Trainer profile screen shows all user information and stats

tests.title: Edit trainer profile information
steps: 1. From trainer profile, tap 'Edit Profile' button
2. Modify fields: bio, experience, profile photo
3. Tap 'Save' button
4. Verify PATCH /api/v1/trainer/profile called with updated data
tests.expected_result: Profile updated successfully, changes persist across restarts

tests.title: Upload trainer profile photo
steps: 1. From Edit Profile, tap on profile photo
2. Select 'Camera' or 'Gallery'
3. Choose/take photo and confirm
4. Verify image compressed and uploaded to server
5. Verify profile photo updates immediately
tests.expected_result: Photo uploaded and displays in profile

tests.title: View trainer verification badge status
steps: 1. On profile screen, check if verification badge displays
2. If not verified, show 'Pending Verification' or 'Get Verified' button
3. Tap to view verification status details
4. Show requirements or progress toward verification
tests.expected_result: Verification status clearly displayed on profile

test_suites.description: Test trainer managing clients (view, add, remove)

tests.title: View all assigned clients
steps: 1. Authenticate as trainer via devtool
2. Navigate to Clients tab
3. Verify GET /api/v1/trainer/clients called with trainer_id
4. Observe list displays: client name, email, photo, status (active/inactive)
5. Verify list is paginated (shows ~20 clients per page)
tests.expected_result: Clients list loads and displays all assigned clients with pagination

tests.title: Search for specific client
steps: 1. On Clients list, tap search input field
2. Type client name or email
3. Observe list filters by search term (debounced 300ms)
4. Verify GET /api/v1/trainer/clients?search=query called
tests.expected_result: Client search works smoothly, results update as typing

tests.title: View client details
steps: 1. Tap on client from list to open client detail screen
2. Verify displays: full profile, assigned workouts, completion stats
3. Verify GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id} called
4. Shows progress metrics: workouts completed, consistency streak
tests.expected_result: Client detail screen loads with comprehensive client info

tests.title: Add new client to trainer account
steps: 1. On Clients list, tap 'Add Client' or '+' button
2. Enter client email address
3. Tap 'Send Invitation'
4. Verify POST /api/v1/trainer/invite endpoint called
5. Show status 'Invitation Sent' with countdown to expiry
tests.expected_result: Client invitation sent, status tracked in UI

tests.title: Remove client from trainer account
steps: 1. From client detail screen, tap 'Remove Client' button
2. Confirm removal in dialog
3. Verify DELETE /api/v1/clients/{client_id} called
4. App navigates back to clients list
5. Verify client removed from list
tests.expected_result: Client removed successfully, list refreshed

tests.title: Filter clients by status (active/inactive)
steps: 1. On Clients list, tap filter icon
2. Select 'Active' or 'Inactive'
3. Verify list updates to show only selected status
4. Verify GET request includes status filter
tests.expected_result: Client list filters correctly by status

test_suites.description: Test trainer creating, editing, and managing workouts

tests.title: View all trainer workouts
steps: 1. Authenticate as trainer via devtool
2. Navigate to Workouts tab
3. Verify GET /api/v1/trainer/workouts called
4. Observe list displays: workout name, # of assigned clients, creation date
5. Verify sorting options: by name, date, usage
tests.expected_result: Workouts list loads with all trainer-created workouts

tests.title: Create new workout
steps: 1. On Workouts list, tap 'Create Workout' button
2. Enter workout details: name, description, duration estimate
3. Add exercises section with set/rep inputs
4. Tap 'Save Draft' to save without publishing
tests.expected_result: Workout saved as draft, can be edited or published later

tests.title: Add exercises to workout
steps: 1. While creating/editing workout, tap 'Add Exercise'
2. Search for exercise by name or select from library
3. Set: sets, reps, weight, rest time, notes for client
4. Tap 'Add' to add exercise to workout
5. Repeat for multiple exercises
tests.expected_result: Exercises added to workout with all details configured

tests.title: Edit existing workout
steps: 1. From Workouts list, tap on workout
2. Tap 'Edit' button to enter edit mode
3. Modify workout details and exercises
4. Tap 'Save' to apply changes
5. Verify PATCH /api/v1/workouts/{id} called
tests.expected_result: Workout updated successfully, changes visible immediately

tests.title: Delete workout
steps: 1. From workout detail, tap 'Delete' button
2. Confirm deletion in dialog
3. Verify DELETE /api/v1/workouts/{id} called
4. Verify workout removed from list
tests.expected_result: Workout deleted successfully, removed from list

tests.title: Publish workout to clients
steps: 1. From workout detail, tap 'Publish' button
2. Select which clients to assign (single/multiple)
3. Set due date (optional)
4. Tap 'Assign' to publish
5. Verify POST /api/v1/workout-assignments called
tests.expected_result: Workout assigned to selected clients

test_suites.description: Test trainer monitoring client progress and completion

tests.title: View client workout completion history
steps: 1. From client detail screen, navigate to 'Workouts' section
2. Verify list shows all assigned workouts with completion status
3. Completed workouts show: completion date, duration, performance notes
4. Incomplete workouts show: due date, days overdue if applicable
tests.expected_result: Workout history displays with completion tracking

tests.title: View client progress metrics
steps: 1. From client detail screen, navigate to 'Progress' tab
2. Verify displays: total workouts assigned, completed, compliance %
3. Show progress trend chart (completion rate over time)
4. Verify GET /api/v1/clients/{id}/progress called
tests.expected_result: Client progress metrics display with visualizations

tests.title: View client custom measurements (photos, weight)
steps: 1. From client detail, navigate to 'Measurements' section
2. Verify displays: timeline of measurements and photos
3. Each entry shows: date, value, progress change from previous
4. Tap on photo to view full-size image
tests.expected_result: Client measurements and progress photos visible

tests.title: Add notes to client workout completion
steps: 1. View completed workout in client history
2. Tap workout to open detail
3. Tap 'Add Notes' or 'Trainer Feedback'
4. Enter feedback on client performance
5. Tap 'Save' to send feedback to client
tests.expected_result: Trainer notes saved and visible to client

test_suites.description: Test trainer analytics and dashboard metrics

tests.title: View trainer dashboard summary
steps: 1. Navigate to Dashboard tab (main view after login)
2. Verify displays: # active clients, total workouts, this week's completion rate
3. Show recent activity: client completions, new clients, messages
4. Verify GET /api/v1/trainer/stats called
tests.expected_result: Dashboard displays key metrics and recent activity

tests.title: View analytics for all clients
steps: 1. Navigate to Analytics tab
2. Verify displays: average completion rate, top performing clients, trends
3. Show chart: workouts assigned vs completed over time
4. Filter by time period: this week, this month, all time
tests.expected_result: Analytics screen shows comprehensive trainer metrics

tests.title: View individual client performance ranking
steps: 1. On Analytics screen, find client ranking/leaderboard section
2. Verify displays: client name, completion rate, streak
3. Tap on client to view detailed performance breakdown
4. Sort by: completion rate, consistency, recent activity
tests.expected_result: Client performance rankings visible and sortable

tests.title: Export analytics report
steps: 1. On Analytics screen, tap 'Export' button
2. Select format: PDF or CSV
3. Verify GET /api/v1/trainer/analytics/export called
4. File downloads to device
tests.expected_result: Analytics report exported successfully

test_suites.description: Test trainer messaging and client communication

tests.title: View messages from all clients
steps: 1. Navigate to Messages tab
2. Verify conversation list shows all clients with active threads
3. Show latest message preview and timestamp
4. Sort by: recent, unread, client name
tests.expected_result: Messages screen displays all client conversations

tests.title: Send message to client
steps: 1. Open conversation with client
2. Type message in text input field
3. Tap Send button
4. Verify message appears locally (optimistic update)
5. Verify POST /api/v1/messages called
tests.expected_result: Message sent and appears in conversation, sync status updated

tests.title: Broadcast message to multiple clients
steps: 1. On Messages tab, tap 'Broadcast' or 'Send to Group'
2. Select multiple clients from list
3. Compose message
4. Tap 'Send to All' to broadcast
5. Verify POST /api/v1/messages/broadcast called
tests.expected_result: Message sent to all selected clients

tests.title: Receive and respond to client messages
steps: 1. Receive message from client (in test, use second instance)
2. Push notification appears (if app backgrounded)
3. Tap notification to navigate to conversation
4. Compose response and send
tests.expected_result: Messages received and responses sent successfully

tests.title: Message persistence and offline sync
steps: 1. Disable internet (airplane mode)
2. Send message to client
3. Verify message saved locally with isSynced=false
4. Re-enable internet, observe sync
5. Verify message delivered after sync
tests.expected_result: Messages persist offline and sync when online

test_suites.description: Test trainer payment management and subscription features

tests.title: View trainer subscription status
steps: 1. Navigate to Subscription or Billing tab
2. Verify subscription status displays (active, trial, cancelled)
3. Verify displays: plan name, price, renewal date
4. Verify GET /api/v1/trainer/subscription returns data

tests.title: Upgrade subscription plan

2. Select higher tier plan (e.g., Professional)
3. Tap 'Upgrade' button
4. Stripe payment sheet opens with upgrade price
tests.expected_result: Payment sheet initializes for plan upgrade

tests.title: Complete subscription payment with test card
steps: 1. In Stripe payment sheet, enter test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242
2. Enter expiry 12/34 and CVC 123
3. Tap 'Pay' button
4. Verify loading state and payment processing
tests.expected_result: Payment succeeds, subscription upgraded, access to premium features

tests.title: View payment history and invoices

2. Verify list shows all past payments with dates and amounts
3. Tap invoice to view PDF or details
4. Option to download invoice
tests.expected_result: Payment history and invoices accessible

tests.title: Cancel subscription

2. Show confirmation dialog with cancellation details
3. Tap 'Confirm Cancellation'
4. Verify subscription remains active until period end
5. Show 'Reactivate' option available
tests.expected_result: Subscription cancelled, pending end of billing period

test_suites.description: Test trainer app settings and account management

tests.title: Access trainer settings screen
steps: 1. Navigate to Settings or Profile menu
2. Verify Settings screen displays
3. Verify sections: Account, Notifications, Business Settings, Privacy, About
tests.expected_result: Settings screen loads with all configuration options

tests.title: Configure notification preferences

3. Observe changes saved to backend (PATCH /api/v1/trainer/settings)
4. Verify FCM token updated with new preferences

tests.title: Configure business settings
steps: 1. In Settings, find 'Business Settings' section
2. Configure: hourly rate, availability calendar, service area
3. Set client capacity limits (max clients per plan)
4. Tap 'Save' to persist

tests.title: Change theme (light/dark/system)
steps: 1. In Settings, find Theme option

tests.title: Connect social media profiles

tests.title: Export business data

tests.title: Logout trainer session
steps: 1. In Settings, tap 'Logout' button

test_suites.description: Test offline-first sync for trainer operations

tests.title: App works in airplane mode
steps: 1. Enable Airplane Mode or disable WiFi/cellular
2. Attempt to navigate between screens
3. View locally cached clients and workouts
4. Create draft workout (saves locally with isSynced=false)
tests.expected_result: App functions normally, no crashes, local actions persist

tests.title: Sync queue tracks pending trainer changes
steps: 1. While offline, create workout and send message
2. Use DevTools to inspect Drift database
3. Verify workout and message have isSynced=false
4. Check sync_queue table has entries for both
tests.expected_result: Pending changes tracked in Drift, ready to sync when online

tests.title: Automatic sync when connectivity restored
steps: 1. While offline, create 2-3 workouts and send messages
2. Disable Airplane Mode to restore connectivity
3. Observe SyncService triggers sync (should happen in 5 min max)
4. Verify in network tab: POST requests for each pending action
tests.expected_result: All pending changes synced automatically, isSynced set to true

tests.title: Offline workout editing
steps: 1. Disable internet
2. Open draft workout and modify it
3. Save changes locally
4. Re-enable internet and trigger sync
5. Verify changes synced to server
tests.expected_result: Offline edits persist and sync when online

test_suites.description: Test trainer app performance, error handling, and edge cases

tests.title: Handle network errors gracefully
steps: 1. While loading client list, kill backend or simulate 500 error
2. Observe error message displayed in UI
3. Verify 'Retry' button available
4. Restore backend and tap Retry
tests.expected_result: Error shown in UI, retry succeeds after fix

tests.title: Handle 401 unauthorized (token expired)
steps: 1. Revoke/expire trainer token on backend
2. Make any request (e.g., fetch clients)
3. App should detect 401 and redirect to login
4. Verify AuthStateProvider invalidated
tests.expected_result: App redirects to login, session cleared

tests.title: Handle 403 forbidden (insufficient permissions)
steps: 1. Attempt to access client from different trainer
2. Backend returns 403 Forbidden
3. App shows error: 'You don't have access to this client'
4. Verify redirect back to clients list
tests.expected_result: Permission error handled gracefully

tests.title: Image caching performance for trainer photos
steps: 1. Load client list with client avatar images
2. Scroll up and down multiple times
3. Monitor memory and network usage in DevTools
4. Verify images use CachedNetworkImage with size limits
tests.expected_result: Images load fast on second scroll, no excessive network requests

tests.title: List pagination (100+ clients)
steps: 1. With many clients assigned, load clients list
2. Verify only 20 items load initially
3. Scroll to bottom to trigger pagination
4. Verify next 20 items load without full refresh
tests.expected_result: Pagination works smoothly, no loading freezes

test_suites.description: Test trainer security and authorization controls

tests.title: Trainer cannot access client-only endpoints
steps: 1. Authenticate as trainer with dev token
2. Attempt GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/my-workouts (client-only)
3. Verify 403 Forbidden response
tests.expected_result: Backend rejects client-only endpoint for trainer role

tests.title: Trainer can only access own clients
steps: 1. Authenticate as trainer A
2. Attempt GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id_from_trainer_b}
3. Verify 403 Forbidden response
4. Verify trainer_id filter enforced on backend
tests.expected_result: Trainer blocked from accessing other trainer's clients

tests.title: Trainer tokens stored securely
steps: 1. After login, verify token stored in flutter_secure_storage
2. Use DevTools to inspect Dart code, verify SecureStorage import
3. Verify NO token in SharedPreferences (grep for token)
4. Token should NOT appear in console logs
tests.expected_result: Tokens stored in secure storage, not visible in logs/prefs

tests.title: Authorization header present in all requests
steps: 1. Authenticate as trainer
2. Make any API request (fetch clients, send message, etc.)
3. In network tab, verify request has: Authorization: Bearer <token>
4. Check AuthInterceptor is working (add debug log)
tests.expected_result: All requests include valid Authorization header

tests.title: Biometric auth enforced on login
steps: 1. Verify biometric is MANDATORY in flow (not optional)
2. After code verification, BiometricAuthScreen must appear
3. Attempt to bypass by navigating directly to dashboard (should fail)
4. Verify token only issued after biometric success
tests.expected_result: Biometric is enforced, cannot skip or bypass

test_suites.description: Test trainer UI, navigation flow, and user experience

tests.title: Navigation between main tabs works smoothly
steps: 1. From dashboard, tap each main tab: Clients, Workouts, Messages, Analytics, Profile
2. Verify each screen loads without errors

4. Verify current tab indicator highlighted
tests.expected_result: Tab navigation fluid, no crashes, correct tab highlighted

tests.title: Loading states show spinners/skeletons
steps: 1. Load client list, observe loading state
2. Use network throttle in DevTools to simulate slow network
3. Verify loading indicator appears while fetching
4. Once loaded, loading indicator disappears
tests.expected_result: Loading states visible to user, no blank screens

tests.title: App follows design system (colors, typography, spacing)
steps: 1. Navigate through app screens
2. Verify colors match design-system.md (lavender, purple, green)
3. Verify typography: Headlines 24px bold, Body 16px regular
4. Verify spacing consistent (8px grid system)
tests.expected_result: App matches design system specifications

tests.title: App responsive on different screen sizes
steps: 1. Test on small phone (320px width)
2. Test on large tablet (1024px width)
3. Verify layout adapts without overflow
4. Verify buttons/text still readable on all sizes
tests.expected_result: App responsive, works on all device sizes

tests.title: Quick action buttons accessible
steps: 1. On dashboard, verify 'Create Workout' button visible and accessible
2. Verify 'Add Client' button visible and accessible
3. Verify floating action buttons (FAB) positioned correctly
4. Tap FAB to verify quick action menu opens
tests.expected_result: Quick actions easily accessible from main screens

test_suites.description: Test trainer public profile discovery and booking features

tests.title: Trainer public profile displays correctly
steps: 1. Logout trainer account
2. From login screen, search for trainer by name
3. Tap trainer to view public profile
4. Verify displays: bio, experience, ratings, hourly rate, availability
tests.expected_result: Trainer public profile visible to unauthenticated users

tests.title: Request session with trainer (client booking)
steps: 1. From trainer public profile, tap 'Book Session' or 'Hire Trainer'
2. Select date/time from trainer's availability calendar
3. Add special requests/notes
4. Tap 'Request Session' to send booking request
tests.expected_result: Booking request sent to trainer

tests.title: Trainer receives booking requests
steps: 1. While logged in as trainer, navigate to Requests or Bookings tab
2. Verify new session requests display with client info
3. Request shows: client name, requested date/time, special requests
4. Tap to view full request details
tests.expected_result: Booking requests visible and actionable

tests.title: Trainer accepts/rejects booking request
steps: 1. From booking request, tap 'Accept' or 'Decline'

accessing_devbar: iOS Simulator: Shake device or Cmd+Ctrl+Z
Android Emulator: Shake emulator or Ctrl+M (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+M (Windows/Linux)
switching_to_trainer_role: 5. Tap 'Apply' - app auto-logs in with dev trainer token
network_inspection: Use Flutter DevTools Network tab to inspect requests
Verify Authorization header present in all requests
database_inspection: Use Flutter DevTools Storage tab to inspect Drift database
Look for tables: users, trainers, clients, workouts, workout_assignments, sync_queue, messages
Verify isSynced flag on offline changes
Inspect sync_queue for pending trainer operations

test_execution_notes: Run tests in debug mode using main_dev.dart (automatically loads DevDataSeeder)
Each test should be independent; can be run in any order
Mark test as 'passes': true only after MANUALLY executing all steps and verifying result
Network logs essential for API tests
Database inspection critical for offline sync tests
Always test both online and offline modes
Test on iOS and Android for comprehensive coverage
Compare trainer and client UI differences (different dashboard, tabs, features)

common_issues.issue: Dev token not working after role switch
common_issues.solution: Kill and restart app, ensure main_dev.dart is running, check DevDataSeeder creates trainer user with correct role
Verify AuthInterceptor is added to Dio, check flutter_secure_storage has token, restart app
Verify DevDataSeeder creates test clients with trainer_id matching authenticated trainer, check filter on GET /api/v1/trainer/clients
Check SyncService is running (background worker), verify isSynced flag on local changes, manually trigger sync or wait 5 minutes

common_issues.issue: Permission denied errors accessing client data
common_issues.solution: Verify client belongs to authenticated trainer, check backend enforces trainer_id filter, verify trainer_id in all requests

common_issues.issue: Workout assignment not visible to client
common_issues.solution: Verify POST /api/v1/workout-assignments succeeded, check client's workout list makes GET request with correct trainer_id filter

authentication.note: Both use same magic link flow

dashboard.trainer: Shows: active clients, workouts, completion stats, analytics
dashboard.client: Shows: assigned workouts, progress metrics, completion rate

client_management.trainer: View all clients, add/remove clients, view progress, send messages
client_management.client: Cannot manage clients (N/A - they are the client)

workout_management.trainer: Create, edit, delete, assign workouts to clients
workout_management.client: View assigned workouts, mark complete, view feedback

payments.trainer: Manage subscription plan, view invoice history
